title: For carcinogenic molecules containing triple bonds, identify which element
question: For carcinogenic molecules containing triple bonds, identify which element appears most frequently across these molecules and calculate what percentage of all triple-bonded molecules are carcinogenic.

prediction.sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id, m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic_flag
  FROM molecule AS m
  INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
  WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
carcinogenic_triple_bond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM triple_bond_molecules
  WHERE carcinogenic_flag = '+'
),
element_counts AS (
  SELECT a.XCL_003 AS element, COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS element_count
  FROM atom AS a
  INNER JOIN carcinogenic_triple_bond AS ct ON a.XCL_002 = ct.molecule_id
  GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
top_element AS (
  SELECT element, element_count
  FROM element_counts
  ORDER BY element_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
percentage_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ct.molecule_id) AS REAL) * 100 / 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM triple_bond_molecules) AS carcinogenic_percentage
  FROM carcinogenic_triple_bond AS ct
)
SELECT 
  te.element AS most_frequent_element,
  pc.carcinogenic_percentage AS percentage_carcinogenic
FROM top_element AS te
CROSS JOIN percentage_calc AS pc

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = 'Triple'
),
carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'Carcinogenic'
),
triple_bond_carcinogenic AS (
    SELECT tbm.molecule_id
    FROM triple_bond_molecules tbm
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON tbm.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_003 AS element, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_carcinogenic tbc ON a.XCL_002 = tbc.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a.XCL_003
),
most_frequent_element AS (
    SELECT element, count
    FROM element_counts
    ORDER BY count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
total_triple_bonded AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM triple_bond_molecules
),
carcinogenic_triple_bonded AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS carcinogenic_count
    FROM triple_bond_carcinogenic
)
SELECT 
    mfe.element AS most_frequent_element,
    (ctb.carcinogenic_count * 100.0) / ttb.total AS percentage_carcinogenic
FROM most_frequent_element mfe
CROSS JOIN total_triple_bonded ttb
CROSS JOIN carcinogenic_triple_bonded ctb
